blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What Stelara is
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Stelara contains the active substance 'ustekinumab' , a monoclonal antibody. Monoclonal antibodies are proteins that recognise and bind specifically to certain proteins in the body.
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Stelara belongs to a group of medicines called 'immunosuppressants' . These medicines work by weakening part of the immune system.
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What Stelara is used for
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Stelara administered using the pre-filled pen is used to treat the following inflammatory diseases:
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Plaque psoriasis - in adults
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Psoriatic arthritis - in adults
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Moderate to severe Crohn's disease - in adults
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Moderate to severe ulcerative colitis - in adults
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis is a skin condition that causes inflammation affecting the skin and nails. Stelara will reduce the inflammation and other signs of the disease.
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Stelara administered using the pre-filled pen is used in adults with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, who cannot use ciclosporin, methotrexate or phototherapy, or where these treatments did not work.
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis is an inflammatory disease of the joints, usually accompanied by psoriasis. If you have active psoriatic arthritis you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough to these medicines, you may be given Stelara to:
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Improve your physical function.
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Slow down the damage to your joints.
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Crohn's disease is an inflammatory disease of the bowel. If you have Crohn's disease you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough or are intolerant to these medicines, you may be given Stelara to reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Ulcerative colitis
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Ulcerative colitis is an inflammatory disease of the bowel. If you have ulcerative colitis you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough or are intolerant to these medicines, you may be given Stelara to reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What Stelara is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not use Stelara
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are allergic to ustekinumab or any of the other ingredients of this medicine (listed in section 6).
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have an active infection which your doctor thinks is important.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you are not sure if any of the above applies to you, talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using Stelara.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Warnings and precautions
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using Stelara. Your doctor will check how well you are before each treatment. Make sure you tell your doctor about any illness you have before each treatment. Also tell your doctor if you have recently been near anyone who might have tuberculosis. Your doctor will examine you and do a test for tuberculosis, before you have Stelara. If your doctor thinks you are at risk of tuberculosis, you may be given medicines to treat it.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Look out for serious side effects
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Look out for serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Stelara can cause serious side effects, including allergic reactions and infections. You must look out for certain signs of illness while you are taking Stelara. See 'Serious side effects' in section 4 for a full list of these side effects.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Look out for serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you ever had an allergic reaction to Stelara. Ask your doctor if you are not sure.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have ever had any type of cancer - this is because immunosuppressants like Stelara weaken part of the immune system. This may increase the risk of cancer.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have been treated for psoriasis with other biologic medicines (a medicine produced from a biological source and usually given by injection) - the risk of cancer may be higher.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have or have had a recent infection.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have any new or changing lesions within psoriasis areas or on normal skin.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have ever had an allergic reaction to latex or Stelara injection - the container of this medicinal product contains latex rubber, which may cause severe allergic reactions in people who are sensitive to latex. See 'Look out for serious side effects' in section 4 for the signs of an allergic reaction.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are having any other treatment for psoriasis and/or psoriatic arthritis - such as another immunosuppressant or phototherapy (when your body is treated with a type of ultraviolet (UV) light). These treatments may also weaken part of the immune system. Using these therapies together with Stelara has not been studied. However it is possible it may increase the chance of diseases related to a weaker immune system.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are having or have ever had injections to treat allergies - it is not known if Stelara may affect these.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are 65 years of age or over - you may be more likely to get infections.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you are not sure if any of the above applies to you, talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using Stelara.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Some patients have experienced lupus-like reactions including skin lupus or lupus-like syndrome during treatment with ustekinumab. Talk to your doctor right away if you experience a red, raised, scaly rash sometimes with a darker border, in areas of the skin that are exposed to the sun or with joint pains.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
Before you use Stelara tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Heart attack and strokes
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Heart attack and strokes have been observed in a study in patients with psoriasis treated with Stelara. Your doctor will regularly check your risk factors for heart disease and stroke in order to ensure that they are appropriately treated. Seek medical attention right away if you develop chest pain, weakness or abnormal sensation on one side of your body, facial droop, or speech or visual abnormalities.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Children and adolescents
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The Stelara pre-filled pen is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age with psoriasis, Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis, because it has not been studied in this age group. The pre-filled syringe or vial should be used instead for children 6 years of age and older and adolescents with psoriasis. The solution for infusion, vial or pre-filled syringe should be used instead for children 2 years of age and older with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Stelara is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age with psoriatic arthritis, or in children under the age of 6 years with psoriasis or children under 2 years of age with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis, because it has not been studied in these age groups.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Other medicines, vaccines and Stelara
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Tell your doctor or pharmacist:
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are taking, have recently taken or might take any other medicines.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have recently had or are going to have a vaccination. Some types of vaccines (live vaccines) should not be given while using Stelara.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you received Stelara while pregnant, tell your baby's doctor about your Stelara treatment before the baby receives any vaccine, including live vaccines, such as the BCG vaccine (used to prevent tuberculosis). Live vaccines are not recommended for your baby in the first twelve months after birth if you received Stelara during the pregnancy unless your baby's doctor recommends otherwise.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Pregnancy and breast-feeding
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or are planning to have a baby, ask your doctor for advice before taking this medicine.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  A higher risk of birth defects has not been seen in babies exposed to Stelara in the womb. However, there is limited experience with Stelara in pregnant women. It is therefore preferable to avoid the use of Stelara in pregnancy.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are a woman of childbearing potential, you are advised to avoid becoming pregnant and must use adequate contraception while using Stelara and for at least 15 weeks after the last Stelara treatment.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Stelara can pass across the placenta to the unborn baby. If you received Stelara during your pregnancy, your baby may have a higher risk for getting an infection.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  It is important that you tell your baby's doctors and other health care professionals if you received Stelara during your pregnancy before the baby receives any vaccine. Live vaccines such as the BCG vaccine (used to prevent tuberculosis) are not recommended for your baby in the first twelve months after birth if you received Stelara during the pregnancy unless your baby's doctor recommends otherwise.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Ustekinumab may pass into breast milk in very small amounts. Talk to your doctor if you are breast-feeding or are planning to breast-feed. You and your doctor should decide if you should breast-feed or use Stelara - do not do both.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Driving and using machines
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Stelara has no or negligible influence on the ability to drive and use machines.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Stelara contains polysorbate 80
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Stelara contains 0.04 mg of polysorbate 80 (E433) in each dosage unit which is equivalent to 0.04 mg/mL. Polysorbates may cause allergic reactions. Tell your doctor if you have any known allergies.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 3. How to use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Stelara is intended for use under the guidance and supervision of a doctor experienced in treating conditions for which Stelara is intended.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Always use this medicine exactly as your doctor has told you. Check with your doctor if you are not sure. Talk to your doctor about when you will have your injections and follow-up appointments.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How much Stelara is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Your doctor will decide how much Stelara you need to use and for how long.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  The recommended starting dose is 45 mg Stelara. Patients who weigh more than 100 kilograms (kg) may start on a dose of 90 mg instead of 45 mg.
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  After the starting dose, you will have the next dose 4 weeks later, and then every 12 weeks. The following doses are usually the same as the starting dose.
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  During treatment, the first dose of approximately 6 mg/kg Stelara will be given by your doctor through a drip in a vein in your arm (intravenous infusion). After the starting dose, you will receive the next dose of 90 mg Stelara after 8 weeks, then every 12 weeks thereafter by an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously').
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  In some patients, after the first injection under the skin, 90 mg Stelara may be given every 8 weeks. Your doctor will decide when you should receive your next dose.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How Stelara is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Stelara is given as an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously'). At the start of your treatment, medical or nursing staff may inject Stelara.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  However, you and your doctor may decide that you may inject Stelara yourself. In this case you will get training on how to inject Stelara yourself.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  For instructions on how to inject Stelara, see 'Instructions for administration' at the end of this leaflet.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Talk to your doctor if you have any questions about giving yourself an injection.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you use more Stelara than you should
section_path: If you use more Stelara than you should
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have used or been given too much Stelara, talk to a doctor or pharmacist straight away. Always have the outer carton of the medicine with you, even if it is empty.
section_path: If you use more Stelara than you should
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you forget to use Stelara
section_path: If you forget to use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you forget a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist. Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten dose.
section_path: If you forget to use Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you stop using Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: It is not dangerous to stop using Stelara. However, if you stop, your symptoms may come back.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have any further questions on the use of this medicine, ask your doctor or pharmacist.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 4. Possible side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Like all medicines, this medicine can cause side effects, although not everybody gets them.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Some patients may have serious side effects that may need urgent treatment.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Serious allergic reactions ('anaphylaxis') are rare in people taking Stelara (may affect up to 1 in 1,000 people). Signs include:
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: o difficulty breathing or swallowing
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: o low blood pressure, which can cause dizziness or light-headedness
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: o swelling of the face, lips, mouth or throat.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Common signs of an allergic reaction include skin rash and hives (these may affect up to 1 in 100 people).
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: In rare cases, allergic lung reactions and lung inflammation have been reported in patients who receive ustekinumab. Tell your doctor right away if you develop symptoms such as cough, shortness of breath, and fever.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have a serious allergic reaction, your doctor may decide that you should not use Stelara again.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Infections of the nose or throat and common cold are common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Infections of the chest are uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Inflammation of tissue under the skin ('cellulitis') is uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Shingles (a type of painful rash with blisters) are uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Stelara may make you less able to fight infections. Some infections could become serious and may include infections caused by viruses, fungi, bacteria (including tuberculosis), or parasites, including infections that mainly occur in people with a weakened immune system (opportunistic infections). Opportunistic infections of the brain (encephalitis, meningitis), lungs, and eye have been reported in patients receiving treatment with ustekinumab.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: You must look out for signs of infection while you are using Stelara. These include:
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  fever, flu-like symptoms, night sweats, weight loss
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  feeling tired or short of breath; cough which will not go away
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  warm, red and painful skin, or a painful skin rash with blisters
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  burning when passing water
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  diarrhoea
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  visual disturbance or vision loss
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  headache, neck stiffness, light sensitivity, nausea or confusion.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of these signs of infection. These may be signs of infections such as chest infections, or skin infections or shingles or opportunistic infections that could have serious complications. Tell your doctor if you have any kind of infection that will not go away or keeps coming back. Your doctor may decide that you should not use Stelara until the infection goes away. Also tell your doctor if you have any open cuts or sores as they might get infected.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Shedding of skin - increase in redness and shedding of skin over a larger area of the body may be symptoms of erythrodermic psoriasis or exfoliative dermatitis, which are serious skin conditions. You should tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of these signs.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Other side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Diarrhoea
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Nausea
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Vomiting
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Feeling tired
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Feeling dizzy
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Headache
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Itching ('pruritus')
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Back, muscle or joint pain
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Sore throat
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Redness and pain where the injection is given
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Sinus infection
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Tooth infections
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Vaginal yeast infection
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Depression
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Blocked or stuffy nose
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Bleeding, bruising, hardness, swelling and itching where the injection is given
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Feeling weak
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Drooping eyelid and sagging muscles on one side of the face ('facial palsy' or 'Bell's palsy'), which is usually temporary
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  A change in psoriasis with redness and new tiny, yellow or white skin blisters, sometimes accompanied by fever (pustular psoriasis)
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Peeling of the skin (skin exfoliation)
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Acne
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 1,000 people):
section_path: Rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 1,000 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Redness and shedding of skin over a larger area of the body, which may be itchy or painful (exfoliative dermatitis). Similar symptoms sometimes develop as a natural change in the type of psoriasis symptoms (erythrodermic psoriasis)
section_path: Rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 1,000 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Inflammation of small blood vessels, which can lead to a skin rash with small red or purple bumps, fever or joint pain (vasculitis)
section_path: Rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 1,000 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10,000 people):
section_path: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10,000 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Blistering of the skin that may be red, itchy, and painful (Bullous pemphigoid).
section_path: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10,000 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Skin lupus or lupus-like syndrome (red, raised scaly rash on areas of the skin exposed to the sun possibly with joint pains).
section_path: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10,000 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Reporting of side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you get any side effects, talk to your doctor or pharmacist. This includes any possible side effects not listed in this leaflet. You can also report side effects directly via the national reporting system listed in Appendix V. By reporting side effects you can help provide more information on the safety of this medicine.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 5. How to store Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Store in a refrigerator (2 °C-8 °C). Do not freeze.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Keep the pre-filled pen in the outer carton in order to protect from light.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If needed, individual Stelara pre-filled pens may also be stored at room temperature up to 30 °C for a maximum single period of up to 30 days in the original carton in order to protect from
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: light. Record the date when the pre-filled pen is first removed from the refrigerator and the discard date in the space provided on the outer carton. The discard date must not exceed the original expiry date printed on the carton. Once a pre-filled pen has been stored at room temperature (up to 30 °C), it should not be returned to the refrigerator. Discard the pre-filled pen if not used within 30 days at room temperature storage or by the original expiry date, whichever is earlier.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Do not shake the pre-filled pen. Prolonged vigorous shaking may damage the medicine.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not use this medicine:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  After the expiry date which is stated on the label and the carton after 'EXP' . The expiry date refers to the last day of that month.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If the liquid is discoloured, cloudy or you can see other foreign particles floating in it (see section 6 'What Stelara looks like and contents of the pack').
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you know, or think that it may have been exposed to extreme temperatures (such as accidentally frozen or heated).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If the product has been shaken vigorously.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Stelara is for single use only. Any unused product remaining in the pre-filled pen should be thrown away. Do not throw away any medicines via wastewater or household waste. Ask your pharmacist how to throw away medicines you no longer use. These measures will help protect the environment.
blocks.speaker: label

Each pre-filled pen contains 90 mg ustekinumab in 1 mL of solution for injection.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: This "Instructions for Use" contains information on how to inject Stelara.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Important
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Stelara comes in a single-dose pre-filled pen containing one 45 mg dose or one 90 mg dose.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: During injection, push handle all the way down until purple body is not visible to inject the full dose. DO NOT LIFT PRE-FILLED PEN during injection! If you do, the pre-filled pen will lock and you will not get the full dose.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If your doctor decides that you or a caregiver may be able to give your injections of Stelara at home, you should receive training on the right way to prepare and inject Stelara using the pre-filled pen. Do not try to inject yourself until you have been trained by your doctor.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Each pre-filled pen can only be used one time. Throw it away (see Step 3) after use even if there is medicine left in it.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not reuse the pre-filled pen.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Do not reuse the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Read these Instructions for Use before using the Stelara pre-filled pen and each time you get a new pre-filled pen. There may be new information. This leaflet does not take the place of talking with your doctor about your medical condition or your treatment.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Do not reuse the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you cannot give yourself the injection:
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Do not reuse the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  ask your doctor or nurse to help you, or
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Do not reuse the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  ask someone who has been trained by a doctor or nurse to give your injections.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Do not reuse the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: To reduce the risk of accidental needle sticks, each pre-filled pen has a needle guard that automatically covers the needle and locks after you have given your injection and the injector is lifted. Do not lift the pre-filled pen during the injection until the injection is complete.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Do not reuse the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The needle cover inside the bottom cap of the pre-filled pen contains latex. Do not handle the needle cover if you are allergic to latex.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Do not reuse the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Please also read the Package Leaflet carefully before starting your injection and discuss any questions you may have with your doctor or nurse.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Do not reuse the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Storage information
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Do not reuse the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Store in refrigerator at 2° to 8 °C. If needed, store at room temperature up to 30 °C for up to 30 days in
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Do not reuse the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Instructions for use Stelara (ustekinumab) injection, for subcutaneous use Pre-filled pen
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Instructions for use Stelara (ustekinumab) injection, for subcutaneous use Pre-filled pen
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: the original carton. Do not return to refrigerator once stored at room temperature.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Instructions for use Stelara (ustekinumab) injection, for subcutaneous use Pre-filled pen
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Do not freeze the pre-filled pen.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Instructions for use Stelara (ustekinumab) injection, for subcutaneous use Pre-filled pen
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Keep the pre-filled pen and all medicines out of reach of children.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Keep the pre-filled pen and all medicines out of reach of children.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Do not shake the pre-filled pen. Shaking may damage the Stelara medicine. If the pre-filled pen has been shaken, do not use it. Get a new pre-filled pen.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Keep the pre-filled pen and all medicines out of reach of children.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Keep the pre-filled pen in the original carton to protect from light and physical damage.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Keep the pre-filled pen in the original carton to protect from light and physical damage.
blocks.speaker: label

section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Need help?
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Call your doctor to talk about any questions you may have. For additional assistance or to share your feedback refer to the Package Leaflet for your local representative contact information.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Preparing to Inject Stelara
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Gather carton(s)
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If refrigerated, remove the pre-filled pen carton(s) from the refrigerator and place on a flat surface. Leave at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before use.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Do not warm any other way.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If your dose is 45 mg, you will receive one 45 mg pre-filled pen.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If your dose is 90 mg, you will receive one 90 mg or two 45 mg pre-filled pens. If you receive two 45 mg pre-filled pens, follow Steps 1-3 for both injections.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Choose a different injection site for the second injection.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Check the expiry date ('EXP') and seals on the carton(s)
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Check the expiry date ('EXP') and seals on the carton(s)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Do not use the pre-filled pen if the seals on the carton are broken or if the expiry date has passed. Do not use the pre-filled pen if it has been kept at room temperature for longer than 30 days or if it has been stored above 30 °C. Call your doctor or pharmacist for a new pre-filled pen.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
Check the expiry date ('EXP') and seals on the carton(s)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Choose injection site
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Select from the following areas for your injection:
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Front of thighs
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Lower stomach area (lower abdomen), except for a 5-centimetre area right around your navel (belly-button)
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If someone else is giving you the injection, they may also use:
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Back of upper arms
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Do not inject into skin that is tender, bruised, red, or hard.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Use a different injection site for each injection.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Wash hands
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Wash your hands well with soap and warm water.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Clean injection site
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Wipe your chosen injection site with an alcohol swab and allow it to dry. Do not touch, fan, or blow on the injection site after you have cleaned it.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Inspect liquid in window
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Choose a well-lit, clean, flat work surface.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Take the pre-filled pen out of the carton and check for damage.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Check the liquid in the viewing window. It should be clear to slightly opalescent and colourless to light yellow and may contain tiny white or clear particles and one or more air bubbles. This is normal.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Do not inject if the liquid is frozen, cloudy, discoloured, or has large particles. Call your doctor or pharmacist for a new pre-filled pen.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 2. Injecting Stelara
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Pull off bottom cap
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Keep hands away from the needle guard after the cap is removed. It is normal to see a few drops of liquid.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Inject Stelara within 5 minutes of removing the cap.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Do not put the cap back on. This could damage the needle.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Do not use a pre-filled pen if it is dropped after removing the cap. Call your doctor or pharmacist for a new pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Place straight on skin. Push handle all the way down until purple body is not visible.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: DO NOT LIFT PRE-FILLED PEN during injection!
section_path: DO NOT LIFT PRE-FILLED PEN during injection!
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you do, the needle guard will lock, showing a yellow band, and you will not get the full dose.
section_path: DO NOT LIFT PRE-FILLED PEN during injection!
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: You may hear a click when the injection begins. Keep pushing.
section_path: DO NOT LIFT PRE-FILLED PEN during injection!
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you feel resistance, keep pushing. This is normal.
section_path: DO NOT LIFT PRE-FILLED PEN during injection!
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The medication injects as you push. Do this at a speed that is comfortable for you.
section_path: DO NOT LIFT PRE-FILLED PEN during injection!
blocks.speaker: label

section_path: DO NOT LIFT PRE-FILLED PEN during injection!
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: clic
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Confirm your injection is complete
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Your injection is complete when:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  The purple body is not visible.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  You cannot press the handle down anymore.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  You may hear a click.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Lift straight up
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The yellow band indicates that the needle guard is locked into place.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 3. After your injection
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Dispose of the pre-filled pen
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Put the used pre-filled pen in a sharps disposal container right away after use.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Do not throw away (dispose of) the pre-filled pens in the household trash.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Do not recycle your used sharps disposal container.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Check injection site
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: There may be a small amount of blood or liquid at the injection site. This is normal. Press a cotton ball or gauze pad to the injection site until any bleeding stops.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Do not rub the injection site.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If needed, cover the injection site with a bandage.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you receive two 45 mg pre-filled pens for a 90 mg dose, repeat Steps 1-3 with the second pre-filled pen. Choose a different injection site for the second injection.
blocks.speaker: label
